scope: post-hoc read-only diagnosis plan, fixed before new retained-rule analysis; registration only now
prior_knowledge: P01o public summary is known: 32 distinct tables, one joined type/state/material-aligned motif; no new body-level diagnosis has been performed for this plan

input_policy.generation_streams: both Rust and Python for every fixed cell, complete saved JSON; no source recomputation
input_policy.custody: verify every original inventory entry, exact inventory membership, manifest/seal links, all 128 cell identities and independent audit/cost receipts; pin every analysis input and semantic source
input_policy.write_policy: new output directory outside original bundle; no original rewrite or seal replacement
input_policy.missingness: retain every table and initial, all absent bodies/incompatible combinations and explicit failure/unresolved states; no favorable-law subset

combination_policy: same table only; all ordered Cartesian combinations, including kind/state/resource failures; body IDs may repeat in different roles; P,C,G are distinct node roles even when kinds coincide; never enumerate concrete bindings

state_abstraction.domain: signed i32 with checked AddState; no wrapping/clamping
state_abstraction.writers: only unary SetState/AddState of the role kind; constants/guards 0..2 or wildcard and deltas +/-1; reject unsupported alphabet
state_abstraction.representation: unions of closed integer intervals; arbitrary finite unary sequences, ignoring scheduling and competition
state_abstraction.phase_policy: filter each reached set by the current role predicate before taking the next closure; preserve accepted/rejected sets and exact order
state_abstraction.initial_policy: all 128 saved kind/state histograms, not concrete rule bindings; original-node state access conditions are specific to the conditional founder scenario, not general bootstrap impossibility
state_abstraction.independent_oracle: five-region quotient: below 0, exact 0/1/2, above 2; compare phase predicate feasibility within validated alphabet, not concrete exterior-state multiplicity

topology_contract.source_validation: verify exact operation operands/order, Structural-only edge creation/deletion, Contact prerequisite for form5, fresh node IDs, ordered-source refunds and leaf-after-edge-removal checks
topology_contract.newborn: no Contact incidence; incoming creation edge must survive for creator recycling; no outgoing Structural edge before its own first birth under these templates
topology_contract.cleanup: form6 removes C->G edge and refunds its edge matter to C, leaving G orphaned; form7 also deletes/refunds leaf G and burns one activation; neither outcome proves execution
topology_contract.leaf: C may be a leaf after its outgoing edge is removed without deleting G; G must be a leaf only for cleanup form7 in the isolated-branch scenario
topology_contract.limits: isolated P-C-G branch, no extra incidence or intervening resource use; report outside-family interference, orphan persistence and unsupported topologies as unresolved

resource_contract.ledger_policy: closed-form conditional balances for the fixed isolated branch only; no mutable world, event queue, operation interpreter or hypothetical trajectory execution
resource_contract.interpretation: nonnegative conditional balances are necessary arithmetic checks, not event reachability, repeated lifecycle or observed chemistry
resource_contract.global_bound: initial activation64, no injection, each birth burns1; retain conservative source bound of at most64 births without treating it as an observed count

verification_policy.checks: invented controls and independent arithmetic/state/topology checks before parsing retained rule bodies; guard against sampler/process imports and process creation; no retained inputs in tests

reporting.unit: body combinations, conditional ledgers and kind/state histograms; not trajectories or independent law replicates
reporting.exclusion_scope: only the named necessary condition or isolated-branch scenario; a broader exact-table exclusion needs separately checked sufficient source premises
reporting.all_rows: all32 table rows, all128 initial rows, all body combinations with reason fields; zero combinations remain explicit

development_limits.policy: cooperative monotonic-time and emitted-byte checks; explicit bounded failure receipts and no RSS/hard-time claim; source and inputs snapshotted; original sampling budgets unchanged

failure_policy: retain every analysis/test attempt with source/input identities; implementation repairs may repeat only this same read-only plan into a new directory; never repair sampled inputs, alter frozen scientific contracts or replace the consumed census
decision: stop after complete all-table review and independent audit; state one separately justified next boundary; no sampling, favorable-law dynamics, environment/detector change or E01 follows automatically
